brand.name: FleetVane
brand.description: FleetVane is a modern logistics orchestration platform that streamlines fleet operations, real-time tracking, and delivery management for enterprises of all sizes.

landing.heroSubtitle: FleetVane empowers logistics teams with real-time visibility, intelligent route optimization, and seamless coordination across your entire fleet operation.
landing.trustedBy: Trusted by leading logistics companies across India
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Run Your Fleet
landing.featuresSubtitle: From dispatch to delivery, FleetVane covers every aspect of modern fleet management with enterprise-grade reliability.
landing.feature1Desc: Monitor every vehicle in your fleet on a real-time interactive map. Get instant visibility into locations, routes, and estimated arrival times.
landing.feature2Desc: Track shipments from request to delivery with a clear milestone pipeline. Clients get transparent, Flipkart-style progress updates.
landing.feature3Desc: Assign drivers, manage schedules, and collect incident reports — all from a unified management console built for operations teams.
landing.feature4Desc: Optimize routes with real-time traffic data. Reduce fuel costs and delivery times with smart route planning and live traffic overlay.
landing.feature5Desc: Secure, purpose-built portals for clients, drivers, and managers. Each role sees exactly what they need — nothing more, nothing less.
landing.feature6Desc: JWT-based authentication with strict role enforcement. Your fleet data stays protected with industry-standard security practices.
landing.vehiclesSubtitle: FleetVane supports a wide range of commercial vehicles, from light-duty vans to heavy-duty trucks, ensuring complete fleet coverage.
landing.vehicle1Desc: Ideal for last-mile delivery and urban logistics operations.
landing.vehicle2Desc: Perfect for intercity freight and regional distribution networks.
landing.vehicle3Desc: Built for long-haul transportation and heavy cargo operations.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Transform Your Fleet Operations?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join hundreds of logistics companies already streamlining their operations with FleetVane.
